scanNote:
GRAMMAR 20-BET. Unit 4 — buyruq gap va Present Simple mashqlari.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 7-mashq davomi (4), 8-mashq (6 moslash + 5 gap), 9-mashq (12 fe'l shakli), 10-mashq (dialoglar), 11-mashq (4 gap), 12-mashq (11 gap) — jami 40 dan ortiq javob.

⚠ 8-MAShQ — GAP IKKIGA BO'LINGAN: chap ustunda fe'l ('Wake', 'Look'), o'ng ustunda davomi ('up. You're late!'). Javob: 1d, 2a, 3e, 4b, 5f, 6c.
  ⚠ Kalit — FE'L bilan PREDLOG mosligi: wake UP, look AT, help ME, give TO, do (homework), go TO.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — IMLO QOIDALARI AMALDA: watch → watchES ('-ch' bilan tugagan); qolganlariga oddiy '-s'. 'have' → HAS va 'be' → IS — noto'g'ri fe'llar.

⚠ 12-MAShQ — TO'RT YUZ BELGISI:
  ikki jilmayish = LOVE   · bitta jilmayish = LIKE
  qoshi chimirilgan = NOT LIKE  · burishgan = HATE
  ⚠ 'not like' inkor shaklda yoziladi ('doesn't like'), qolgan uchtasi tasdiqda.
  ⚠ Uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' esdan chiqmasin: 'Terry HATES', 'George LIKES', 'Rebecca DOESN'T like'.

⚠ 11 va 12-MAShQ — 'LIKE' DAN KEYIN -ING: like/love/hate dan keyin fe'l '-ing' shaklida keladi ('likes exercisING', 'hates wakING up'). O'zbekchada bu tuzilma yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word(s) in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin yozilgan to'g'ri so'z(lar)ni tanlang (19-betdagi 7-mashqning davomi).
exercises.explanationUz:
Bir xil tekshiruv:
  keyin OT bormi? → sifat yoki ism + 's
  ot yo'qmi?      → egalik olmoshi
  ikki egasi bo'lsa → 's faqat oxirgi ismga

items.whyUz: Gap oxirida, ot yo'q → egalik OLMOSHI 'ours'.
Bitta televizor, ikki egasi → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga.
'father' oti bor → egalik SIFATI 'my'. 'mine father' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the numbers to the letters, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir buyruq FE'L bilan boshlanadi va davomi bilan
ma'noli gap hosil qiladi.

MANTIQNI QUYIDAGICHA TOPING:
  Wake ... — 'wake up' turg'un birikma
  Look ... — 'look at' predlogini talab qiladi
  Help ... — kimga? → obyekt olmoshi
  Give this ... — kimga? → 'to' + ism
  Do ... — nimani? → ish/vazifa
  Go ... — qayerga? → 'to' + joy

DIQQAT: barcha gaplar BUYRUQ — ega yo'q, fe'l asos shaklida.

pairs.note: Kitobdagi namuna. 'wake up' — uyg'onmoq. 'You're late' — kechikding.
'help' to'g'ridan-to'g'ri obyekt oladi — predlog kerak emas.

exercises.explanationUz: Moslashdan keyin har bir gapni to'liq yozing.

Help me! I can't move!
Give this to Liz. It's hers.
Do your homework, now!

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verb.
exercises.explanationUz:
Barchasi 3-shaxs birlik ('he') uchun.

IMLO QOIDALARI:
  oddiy -s  — ko'p fe'llar
  -es       — -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa
  -ies      — undosh + y

IKKI ISTISNO — bu fe'llar QOIDAGA BO'YSUNMAYDI:
  I am  → he IS   ('ams' EMAS!)
  I have → he HAS  ('haves' EMAS!)

Bu ikkalasi eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llar, shuning uchun
ularning noto'g'ri shaklini yodlab olish shart.

items.whyUz: ISTISNO! 'to be' fe'li: I am, you are, he IS.
Oddiy -s, lekin talaffuzi /ɪz/ — 'use' /z/ tovushi bilan tugaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogues, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBGA QARAB SAVOLNI TIKLANG:

  javob 'Yes, she does'   → savol 'Does she ...?'
  javob 'No, he doesn't'  → savol 'Does he ...?'
  javob 'Yes, they do'    → savol 'Do they ...?'
  javob 'He's tall...'    → savol 'What does ... look like?'
  javob 'kind and patient' → savol 'What's ... like?' → 'He's ...'

DIQQAT: savolda fe'l -s OLMAYDI.

lines.textEn: Does she like going to the cinema?

lines.hintUz: Javob 'No, he doesn't' — qaysi shaxs va qaysi yordamchi?
lines.whyUz: Javobda 'he doesn't' → savolda 'Does he'. Fe'l 'work' asos shaklida.

lines.textEn: Does he like living in the city?

lines.whyUz: Javobda 'she does' → savolda 'Does she'. Fe'l 'hate' asos shaklida.
Javobda 'he does' → savolda 'Does he'. 'on Saturdays' — har shanba.
TASHQI KO'RINISH savoli: What DOES ... look like? Javob 'He's tall and very handsome'.

lines.uz: U baland bo'yli va juda kelishgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA:
  Theresa (✓) exercising (✗) reading
  → Theresa likes exercising but she doesn't like reading.

QOLIP:
  EGA + likes/like + ✓ + BUT + olmosh + doesn't/don't like + ✗

IKKI QAROR:
  1) Ega 3-shaxs birlikmi?
     Ha  → likes ... doesn't like
     Yo'q → like ... don't like

  2) Ikkinchi qismda ISM o'rniga OLMOSH ishlatiladi:
     Theresa → she,  Nicole → she,  He → he,
     They → they,    We → we

DIQQAT: 'like' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi (exercising, reading).
Lekin ot bo'lsa o'zgarmaydi (football, tennis, dogs, cats).

example.en: Theresa likes exercising but she doesn't like reading.
example.uz: Teresa sport bilan shug'ullanishni yoqtiradi, lekin o'qishni yoqtirmaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: He likes travelling but he doesn't like fishing.
modelSentences.uz: U sayohat qilishni yoqtiradi, lekin baliq ovlashni yoqtirmaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: They like football but they don't like tennis.
modelSentences.uz: Ular futbolni yoqtiradi, lekin tennisni yoqtirmaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: Nicole likes dogs but she doesn't like cats.
modelSentences.uz: Nikol itlarni yoqtiradi, lekin mushuklarni yoqtirmaydi.

modelSentences.sentence: We like playing games but we don't like watching TV.
modelSentences.uz: Biz o'yin o'ynashni yoqtiramiz, lekin televizor ko'rishni yoqtirmaymiz.

exercises.instructionEn: First, look at the key, then use the prompts to write sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval kalitga qarang, so'ng berilgan so'zlar bilan gap yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT (kitobdagi to'rt yuzcha):
  ☺ katta tabassum — LOVE      (juda yaxshi ko'radi)
  ☺ oddiy tabassum — LIKE      (yoqtiradi)
  ☹ xafa yuz       — NOT LIKE  (yoqtirmaydi)
  ☹ jahldor yuz    — HATE      (yomon ko'radi)

TO'RT DARAJA — ikkitasi ijobiy, ikkitasi salbiy.

INKOR SHAKLI ('not like' uchun):
  he/she/it → DOESN'T like
  I/you/we/they → DON'T like

TASDIQ SHAKLI ('love', 'like', 'hate' uchun):
  he/she/it → loveS / likeS / hateS
  I/you/we/they → love / like / hate

Barcha fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING oladi.

modelSentences.uz: Terri klassik musiqa tinglashni yomon ko'radi.

modelSentences.sentence: Adam and Kelly don't like exercising.
modelSentences.uz: Adam va Kelli sport bilan shug'ullanishni yoqtirmaydi.

They hate cleaning the house.

modelSentences.uz: Men sayohat qilishni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

modelSentences.sentence: George likes playing computer games.

modelSentences.word: 11. He — LIKE / walking in the park
modelSentences.sentence: He likes walking in the park.

modelSentences.word: 12. David and Anna — HATE / waking up early
modelSentences.sentence: David and Anna hate waking up early.
modelSentences.uz: Devid va Anna erta turishni yomon ko'radi.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 20-bet — noto'g'ri fe'llar va uy ishlari.

groups.explanationUz: Bu ikkita fe'l qoidaga bo'ysunmaydi. Ular eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llar, shuning uchun alohida yodlanadi.
Ko'p uy ishlari 'do the ...' shaklida aytiladi. Bu turg'un birikmalar.
Ba'zi fe'llar predlog talab qiladi, ba'zilari yo'q. Buni yodlab olish kerak.
Faqat 'not like' uchun don't/doesn't kerak. Qolganlari to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatiladi.

items.derived: he doesn't like / they don't like

patterns.exampleEn: Wake up. You're late! Look at her! Help me!
patterns.exampleUz: Uyg'on. Kechikding! Unga qara! Menga yordam ber!
patterns.explanationUz: Buyruqda ega yo'q. Ba'zi fe'llar predlog talab qiladi (look AT), ba'zilari yo'q (help me).

patterns.formula: Does + he/she + fe'l (asos) + ...? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Does he work at the local school? — No, he doesn't.
patterns.exampleUz: U mahalliy maktabda ishlaydimi? — Yo'q, ishlamaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Javobdan savolni tiklash mumkin: 'he doesn't' → 'Does he ...?'

patterns.formula: EGA + likes + ✓ + BUT + olmosh + doesn't like + ✗
patterns.exampleEn: Theresa likes exercising but she doesn't like reading.
patterns.exampleUz: Teresa sport bilan shug'ullanishni yoqtiradi, lekin o'qishni yoqtirmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikkinchi qismda ISM o'rniga OLMOSH keladi.
3-shaxs birlikda: likes ... doesn't like.

patterns.formula: EGA + like/don't like + ✓ + BUT + olmosh + don't like + ✗
patterns.exampleEn: They like football but they don't like tennis.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular futbolni yoqtiradi, lekin tennisni yoqtirmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plik ega bilan: like ... don't like (-s YO'Q).

patterns.exampleEn: We love going to the cinema. They hate cleaning the house.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz kinoga borishni juda yaxshi ko'ramiz. Ular uyni tozalashni yomon ko'radi.
patterns.explanationUz: Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING oladi.

patterns.formula: What does + ISM + look like? ↔ What's + ISM + like?
patterns.exampleEn:
What does Steve look like? — He's tall and very handsome.
What's your brother like? — He's kind and patient.
patterns.exampleUz:
Stiv qanday ko'rinadi? — U baland bo'yli va juda kelishgan.
Akang qanday odam? — U mehribon va sabrli.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birinchisi TASHQI KO'RINISH ('look like' + DOES),
ikkinchisi XARAKTER ('be like' — 'does' kerak emas).
